crosscheck.agreement: 10 of 12 points re-read identically (to the 0.1 % rounding of the Akbari table) in Akbari set 1 ('cleaned sample') of Au.csv; differing: 0.61 keV Joy 0.367 vs Akbari no point at this energy; 1.51 keV Joy 0.411 vs Akbari no point at this energy (Joy's value is stored)
